fileNodes.name: wiz_claw.h
fileNodes.summary: Core shared header for the wiz-claw AI agent library, defining common error codes (wiz_claw_err_t), overridable logging macros (WIZ_CLAW_LOG_I/W/E), and the heap string formatting utility wiz_claw_dup_printf. Has no external project-internal dependencies, making it the foundational base included by all other wiz-claw headers.

fileNodes.name: wiz_claw_http.h
fileNodes.summary: HTTP/1.1 client interface header for the wiz-claw library, declaring low-level TCP helpers (connect, close, send, recv) and high-level HTTP callback functions compatible with LLM and Telegram transport function pointer signatures. Defines socket number assignments and configurable buffer size constants for header and body data.

fileNodes.name: wiz_claw_net.h
fileNodes.summary: Network initialization, DNS resolution, and DHCP helper header for the wiz-claw library, wrapping ioLibrary_Driver's DNS and DHCP modules with wiz-claw error types. Declares configuration struct and API functions for DNS lookup, DHCP lease acquisition, and the required 1-second periodic tick handler.

fileNodes.name: wiz_claw_telegram.h
fileNodes.summary: Telegram Bot API client interface header defining types and function declarations for polling updates, parsing incoming messages, and sending text replies. HTTP transport is injected via the wiz_claw_http_call_fn function pointer, keeping TLS and socket concerns outside this module.

fileNodes.name: wiz_claw_tls.h
fileNodes.summary: mbedTLS client interface header for the wiz-claw library, providing a TLS session context struct (wiz_claw_tls_t) that wraps mbedTLS entropy, CTR-DRBG, SSL, and X.509 certificate objects alongside a WIZnet socket number. Declares the full TLS lifecycle API: init, connect, write, read, close, and free.

fileNodes.name: cJSON.h
fileNodes.summary: Vendored cJSON 1.7.18 library header defining the core JSON node structure, type constants, memory hook typedefs, and the full public API (~60 function declarations) for parsing, serializing, and manipulating JSON trees on embedded targets.

fileNodes.name: wiz_claw_agent.h
fileNodes.summary: Agent loop interface header that defines the tool-handler callback typedef, agent configuration struct (LLM config, system prompt, tool JSON, handler, max iterations), and the single-turn entry point wiz_claw_agent_run() which drives the LLM to tool-call to re-invoke loop.

fileNodes.name: wiz_claw_llm.h
fileNodes.summary: LLM client interface header for an OpenAI-compatible chat API, declaring the HTTP POST callback typedef, tool-call and response structs, client configuration struct, the wiz_claw_llm_chat() function, and conversation-history session helpers (create, append user/assistant/tool messages).
